name: median_filter_denoising
decomposition_rationale: Median filtering is usually implemented as a single highly optimized C-extension loop (e.g., in scipy.ndimage). Decomposing the loop itself is unsafe, so it is registered as an atomic node with robust boundary padding validation.

atomic_nodes.name: apply_median_filtering_pass
atomic_nodes.semantic_role: Applies a sliding-window median filter to a multi-dimensional array.
atomic_nodes.witness_shape_semantics: Preserves the spatial dimensions of the input array.
atomic_nodes.complexity_reasoning: Applies sorting of neighborhood elements for each pixel in the image.
